project.name: osgi/domains/bbox
project.description: The bbox domain: the contact toward the Bouygues Bbox router (DHCP reservation reconciliation). bbox-contract declares the neutral reconcile verb (BboxReconciler) over a home vocabulary (no java-bbox-api-client type crosses); bbox-core holds the pure BlueprintRowEnumerator logic; bbox-edge is the @Component that embeds the client (like dbus-systemd embeds dbus-java) and translates home↔library; the scion resolves the reconciler and drives it in-container.
